chunks: From him, from al-Barqi, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"There is no prayer for the one who is holding urine, nor for the woman who is holding urine, and he is in the same status as one who is in his garment."
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on prayer for someone holding their urine?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) via the chain of al-Barqi and Ibn Abi Umayr, establishing that holding urine invalidates prayer due to the distraction and impurity it entails. The comparison to wearing an impure garment (*thawb*) highlights that just as physical impurity on clothing disrupts ritual purity, the internal retention of waste creates a state of spiritual and physical incompleteness that precludes valid worship.
